newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares fall prey to technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares fall prey to technical correction.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 1.7 percent on Friday on what traders said was a technical correction after yesterday's four percent jump.
"I don't expect major changes until the end of this month, unless some fresh information about foreign investors becomes available," said Bojan Sekavcnik, a trader at brokerage PM & A.
In February the central bank restricted international investors' access to the market by ordering them to open custody accounts.
* The SBI index fell 23.11 points to 1,333.14.
* Overall six shares fell, eight rose and one was flat, while 12 were untraded.
* Turnover fell to 66.7 million tolars from 102.7 million. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
